dialogues.speaker: Alida
dialogues.text: This is the Nasha Express we're talking about, mate! You'd be lucky to find even one piece of real news in ten per day!

dialogues.speaker: Alida
dialogues.text: See, every story that starts with "Sources close to the matter reveal..." is pure fiction, and those "firsthand accounts" are all just paid ad spaces in disguise!

dialogues.speaker: Alida
dialogues.text: Oh, crap. You didn't even pay yet. Why am I telling you all this...

dialogues.speaker: Alida
dialogues.text: #Argh! Forget it! Since you look {M#cool}{F#cute}, just take the advice for free!
